tei:div.tei:p: 1$0000250ye shes rab 'bar las: drag po gtum drag dmar nag gi gsang sgrub bzhugs so:1$0000300

gu ru padma drag po rtsal gyi gsang sgrub ni: ghūhya:saya'u: gru gsum dmar nag chos kyi 'byung gnas dbus: dregs pa rgyal bsen bsnol ba'i gdan steng du: bdag nyid rig rtsal skad cig dran rdzogs su: hūm̐ yig dmar nag tshwa tshwa 'phros pa las: gtum drag dmar nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa: phyag g.yas rdo rje nam mkha'i dbyings su 'phyar: lha srin sde brgyad ma lus zil gyis gnon: g.yon pas lcags sdig nag po pho nyar 'gyed: tshwa tshwa skar ltar 'khrugs shing rgyal bsen gzir: zhal gdangs ljags 'dril rno dkar mche ba gtsigs: smin ma ag tshom me 'bar khro gnyer bsdus: spyan gsum sdang mig bar snang khams su gzigs: glang chen stod g.yogs zhing lpags sked du dkris: stag lpags sham thabs gdug pa sbrul gyis brgyan: g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang rol pas dregs pa brdzis: bde chen 'khor lor 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed: longs spyod 'khor lor dbang chen rta mgrin rgyal: chos kyi 'khor lor thugs mchog gsang ba'i bdag: sprul pa'i 'khor lor mkha' 'gro sde lngar shar: bde skyong 'khor lor yaksha me dbal dang: rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor khro rgyal sku la rdzogs: de ltar gsal ba'i thugs kar nyi gdan la: hūm̐ dmar mtha' skor sngags kyi phreng bas bskor: oṃ āḥhūm̐ artsig nirtsig na mo bha ga wa te hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa: a hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa: 1$0000250sngags kyi phreng ba 'od zer tshwa tshwa 'phro: khro bo'i rgyal po yaksha me dbal ni: rdo rje lcags sdig phur pa 'dzin pa 'phros: 1$0000300badzra hūm̐: yaksha hūm̐: raksha hūm̐: 1$0000250phyogs mtshams steng 'og ma lus 1$0000300hūm̐ 1$0000250gis gang: 1$0000300 gsang sngags rgyal po 'bum tsho bcu gnyis bzla: aḥyaḥmaḥduḥruḥtsaḥshaḥnaḥphaṭa: 'bring gis bdun 'bum sus bzlas pa: khyi dkar byi ba phyi ba bsad: 'bag seng bcom dang glang dmar bshas: de ltar 'grub pa'i mtshan ma 'byung:

gsang ba yang gsang hūm̐ sgrub byed: rdzogs rim drag po'i lha khrid bya: sa ma ya: ma mo e ka dzā ṭī: gza' rā hu la: dam can rdo rje legs pas sruungs shig: ces grogs kyi mchog gyur padma mkha' spyod kyis bskul ngor/ bdag 'dra klong gsal snying pos dag par phab pa'o// dge'o// //
